title: One secant step
statement:
$f(x) = x^2 - [$c]$ with $x_{i-1} = [$p]$ and $x_i = [$q]$. Compute $x_{i+1}$ with the secant formula.

[______]{a}
solution: $f([$p]) = [$p]^2-[$c]$ and $f([$q]) = [$q]^2-[$c]$; for $f(x) = x^2 - c$ the secant formula simplifies to $(x_{i-1}x_i + c)/(x_{i-1}+x_i) = ([$p]\cdot[$q]+[$c])/([$p]+[$q])$.
